browser එක සුදුසු control එක Jපන්වනවා.
A signup form collects an email and password.
1 User enters data · 2 Browser validates · 3 Submit button · 4 Server receives request
Read the numbered stages from top to bottom. User enters data; Server receives request.

<form action="/signup" method="post">
 <label>Email <input name="email" type="email" required></label>
 <label>Password <input name="password" type="password" required></label>
 <button type="submit">Sign up</button>
</form>
Expected result: Email and masked password inputs; valid submit sends a POST request.
Interview question: Does type=password encrypt the password?
Answer: No. It masks the display; HTTPS is needed for transport security.
